tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page itself: the full-bleed background every look starts from. Grain and washes sit on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: One step off the paper: bands, the shelf's board, the read-aloud bar's track, a caption's label.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: A sheet laid on the paper: book pages, cards, dialogs, the drawer. Deckled or taped, never a plain floating box.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Pencil lines: dividers, outlines of quiet controls, empty sticker slots. In Ink Blot and Comix it is a real border (3:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Story text and display type on paper, surface, page and scrim.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Second voice: captions, credits, hints, the price tag's small print. On paper, surface, page and scrim.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE accent: the one thing to do now (the primary button, the current stone, the open tab). Aliases the look's pigment. Text on paper, surface, page and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Thinned accent behind accent text: the selected row, the current word being read, a stone's halo.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill.

tokens.name: cue
tokens.usage: The brook's color: links, the read-aloud highlight edge, 'tap', 'drag' and 'say it' hints, the path through the page.

tokens.name: cue-soft
tokens.usage: Thinned cue: the word being read aloud, hover wash on links and rows.

tokens.name: on-cue
tokens.usage: Label on a cue fill.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links: alias of cue, with a wavy underline.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors only, always with a word or an icon.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px at 3px offset (5px on the TV density). 3:1 or more on every ground in every look.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Veil behind dialogs and over busy art under text.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Fixed bars: the read-aloud bar, the shelf's top bar.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Pigment: quinacridone rose. The accent of Meta Daylight, Ink Blot (as black), Comix (magenta) and Origami (vermilion).

tokens.name: rose-soft
tokens.usage: Thinned rose over the paper: behind rose text, a tinted row, a sticker's halo.

tokens.name: on-rose
tokens.usage: Label on a rose fill.

tokens.name: cerulean
tokens.usage: Pigment: cerulean. The brook and every cue in most looks; indigo in Origami, cyan in Comix.

tokens.name: cerulean-soft
tokens.usage: Thinned cerulean over the paper: behind cerulean text, a tinted row, a sticker's halo.

tokens.name: on-cerulean
tokens.usage: Label on a cerulean fill.

tokens.name: sap
tokens.usage: Pigment: sap green. Growth and success: an unlocked stone, a found thing. The cue of Skein silk (the mint cardigan).

tokens.name: sap-soft
tokens.usage: Thinned sap over the paper: behind sap text, a tinted row, a sticker's halo.

tokens.name: on-sap
tokens.usage: Label on a sap fill.

tokens.name: gamboge
tokens.usage: Pigment: new gamboge. Sun, stars and nougat glints; the candle accent of Knight Night. Below text contrast on light papers: fills, marks and 24px+ type only there.

tokens.name: gamboge-soft
tokens.usage: Thinned gamboge over the paper: behind gamboge text, a tinted row, a sticker's halo.

tokens.name: on-gamboge
tokens.usage: Label on a gamboge fill.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: Pigment: copper. Thread, braids and the accent of Skein silk.

tokens.name: copper-soft
tokens.usage: Thinned copper over the paper: behind copper text, a tinted row, a sticker's halo.

tokens.name: on-copper
tokens.usage: Label on a copper fill.

tokens.name: wash-sky
tokens.usage: Watercolor wash: the sky at the top of a page. Decorative only, never under small text without a scrim.

tokens.name: wash-meadow
tokens.usage: Watercolor wash: the meadow at the foot of a page.

tokens.name: wash-rose
tokens.usage: Watercolor wash: blush behind a character or a reward.

tokens.name: wash-sun
tokens.usage: Watercolor wash: the sun's halo, a nougat's glow.

tokens.name: wash-brook
tokens.usage: Watercolor wash: the brook's broad stroke (the cue line rides inside it).

tokens.name: art-line
tokens.usage: Ink line of every drawing: characters, nougats, stones, icons drawn large.

tokens.name: art-light
tokens.usage: Highlights in drawings: the catchlight, the shine on a wrapper.

tokens.name: art-shade
tokens.usage: Shadow fill in drawings, and the shadow under a stone.

tokens.name: art-stone
tokens.usage: A stepping stone's top.

tokens.name: art-water
tokens.usage: Water inside drawings: ripples, the brook's sparkle dashes.

tokens.name: nougat
tokens.usage: The nougat itself (the reward).

tokens.name: nougat-nut
tokens.usage: Nuts in the nougat; caramel lines.

tokens.name: wrapper
tokens.usage: The nougat's twist wrapper.

tokens.name: tag-sun
tokens.usage: Categorical tag (first of five: sun, rose, lilac, sea, sky). Text and dot on paper and page; fill is this at 12%.

tokens.name: tag-rose
tokens.usage: Categorical tag. Text and dot on paper and page.

tokens.name: tag-lilac
tokens.usage: Categorical tag. Text and dot on paper and page.

tokens.name: tag-sea
tokens.usage: Categorical tag. Text and dot on paper and page.

tokens.name: tag-sky
tokens.usage: Categorical tag. Text and dot on paper and page.

families.display: "DynaPuff", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", system-ui, sans-serif
families.old: "IM Fell English", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif
families.fold: "Zen Maru Gothic", "Hiragino Maru Gothic ProN", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the title on the paper. clamp(56px, 9vw, 112px); never all caps. The look swaps the family (Knight Night and Ink Blot: IM Fell English; Comix: Bangers; Origami: Zen Maru Gothic; Skein silk: Caveat).

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Section titles, game titles on covers, dialog headings. clamp(30px, 3.6vw, 44px).

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Card titles, sticker names, the price on a tag.

styles.name: story-lede
styles.sample: The brook went on without asking, so Dora went with it.
styles.usage: The first paragraph of a page, and read-aloud text on covers. clamp(20px, 2vw, 26px); 34em max.

styles.name: story-body
styles.sample: Each stone was warm from the sun, and each one hummed a little when you stood on it.
styles.usage: Story text on book pages. clamp(18px, 1.2vw + 12px, 22px); 60ch max.

styles.name: story-italic
styles.sample: said the octopus, mostly to herself
styles.usage: Asides, speech tags, the narrator's voice in a balloon.

styles.name: dropcap
styles.usage: The illuminated first letter of a chapter (DropCap), sitting on a wash blot.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons and tabs. Sentence case, a verb first.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, menu items, the read-aloud bar.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Plays free while prices are a preview
styles.usage: Fine print and credits. Never below 14px; 18px on the TV density.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: Counters: the nougat jar, stones walked, stickers found. tabular-nums.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Margin notes, a hint written beside a drawing, the label on a jar. Short: five words or fewer.

styles.name: comic-shout
styles.usage: Comix only: sound words and panel titles.

styles.name: balloon
styles.sample: Is that a nougat in the brook?
styles.usage: Speech balloon text in every look (Comix sets every UI label in it too).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: a title and its line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside chips and tags; between a tag and the price.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Paragraph gap; button padding inline.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; between cards on a bank.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between a title block and its story.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups on a page.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between pages of a scrolling story.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between banks of the brook on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed art and comic panels.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and small labels.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Fields, rows, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Pages, dialogs, the drawer.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Big rounded tiles and the read-aloud bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the brook's stones.

tokens.name: shadow-page
tokens.usage: A sheet resting on the paper: pages, cards, dialogs. Ink Blot swaps it for a 1px black edge; Comix for a hard offset.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A sheet picked up: a focused or hovered cover, a dragged page.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Stickers, price tags and seals: a thin rim and a short drop.

tokens.name: shadow-seal
tokens.usage: The wax seal's emboss (primary buttons in Meta Daylight, the Seal component).

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: text-shadow for display type laid over a wash or a drawing.

tokens.name: z-art
tokens.usage: Washes, the brook and drawings.

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: Pages and story text.

tokens.name: z-stone
tokens.usage: Stones and hotspots over art.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: The shelf's top bar and chapter tabs.

tokens.name: z-reader
tokens.usage: The read-aloud bar.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: The drawer and its veil.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the sticker reveal.

tokens.name: z-drop
tokens.usage: A nougat in flight to the jar.

tokens.name: dur-tap
tokens.usage: Press and release.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Hover lifts, a focus ring arriving.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers, a sticker peeling in.

tokens.name: dur-turn
tokens.usage: A page turn or a fold.

tokens.name: dur-drop
tokens.usage: A nougat's flight to the jar.

tokens.name: dur-bleed
tokens.usage: A wash blooming in, the brook drawing itself once.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things that arrive: dialogs, stickers, a lifted cover.

tokens.name: ease-paper
tokens.usage: Turns and folds: paper has weight at the start.

tokens.name: ease-bounce
tokens.usage: A nougat landing in the jar, a stone hopped on. Once, never on a loop.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: Two banks of the brook; the read-aloud bar shows its voice name.

tokens.name: bp-expanded
tokens.usage: Book spreads show two pages; the shelf shows three covers a row.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Wide and 4K: the fluid root size takes over (see size-root).

tokens.name: bp-tv
tokens.usage: Big screens: with a remote or a gamepad the TV density switches on.

tokens.name: size-root
tokens.usage: The root font size: 16px on phones and laptops, growing on 4K and 5K screens so the page reads from a sofa. Everything else is in rem.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Minimum target for anything pressable (64px on the TV density).

tokens.name: size-stone
tokens.usage: A stepping stone's hit area on the brook.

tokens.name: size-cover
tokens.usage: A game cover's width on the shelf (portrait, 3:4).

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for story text.

tokens.name: size-page
tokens.usage: One book page's max width; a spread is two.

tokens.name: size-reader
tokens.usage: The read-aloud bar's max width.

tokens.name: size-jar
tokens.usage: The nougat jar.

tokens.name: size-container
tokens.usage: Max width of shelves and docs; washes and the brook keep going.

tokens.name: op-grain
tokens.usage: Paper grain over grounds (multiply on light papers, soft light on Knight Night; off in Ink Blot).

tokens.name: op-wash
tokens.usage: A wash's peak opacity at its heart.

tokens.name: op-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (always with a reason nearby, which never takes this opacity). Locked stones dim their face instead, so their labels stay readable.

tokens.name: border-pencil
tokens.usage: Quiet outlines and dividers.

tokens.name: border-ink
tokens.usage: Inked outlines: secondary buttons, stones, the jar.

tokens.name: border-comix
tokens.usage: Comix panels and balloons.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width (5px on the TV density).

tokens.name: border-focus-offset
tokens.usage: Focus ring offset.

tokens.name: shape-blob
tokens.usage: A wash blot or a sticker: never a perfect circle.

tokens.name: shape-stone
tokens.usage: A stepping stone's top.

tokens.name: shape-seal
tokens.usage: A wax seal's slightly uneven rim.

tokens.name: shape-tag
tokens.usage: The price tag's body (the hole and string are drawn).

tokens.name: density-regular
tokens.usage: Phones, tablets, laptops and hi-DPI desktops.

tokens.name: density-kid
tokens.usage: Kids reading level: bigger story text and targets.

tokens.name: density-tv
tokens.usage: The 53L TV and any remote or gamepad driven big screen: targets 64px+, focus 5px, one row of covers in focus.

tokens.name: tex-grain-size
tokens.usage: Tile size of the paper grain.

tokens.name: tex-deckle
tokens.usage: Displacement of a page's deckled edge, in px.

tokens.name: tex-bleed
tokens.usage: How far a wash's edge wanders, in px.

tokens.name: tex-halftone
tokens.usage: Comix halftone dot pitch.
